r? @compiler-errors , since you already did #139411 and got randomly selected for #139638 (feel free to reassign!)

Another one similar in spirit to #139411, but this time for `simplify_primitive_clone`, which is doing a bit of redundant work. Might not show up in benches, but probably worth micro-optimizing since the transformation is run even for debug builds.

See inline comments for my reasoning for making these changes.
pr.author: yotamofek

processing.reason: PR #139644 is explicitly a micro-optimization that removes redundant work from `InstSimplify::simplify_primitive_clone`; it is not a semantic miscompile. The original and rewritten guards are equivalent: `target: Some(destination_block)` replaces a separate `Some` unwrap, call arity remains enforced by `let [arg] = &args[..]`, `fn_args.len() != 1` only inspected the CloneFn callee's generic args (always one) rather than MIR call arity, the `CloneFn` and `is_trivially_pure_clone_copy` checks are merely reordered, and reusing `arg` instead of `take_array(args)` extracts the same already-matched argument. The emitted assignment from the dereferenced argument plus `Goto { target: destination_block }` is unchanged. The supplied historical material contains no regression-test hunk and no evidence of a wrong-value transformation, so there is no source-grounded original/incorrect function pair to validate.

analysis.originalLogic: Before this optimization, `simplify_primitive_clone` matched a mutable `TerminatorKind::Call`, required exactly one MIR call argument with `let [arg] = &args[..]`, separately unwrapped `target`, obtained `(fn_def_id, fn_args)` from `func.const_fn_def()`, checked `fn_args.len() != 1`, required the argument type to be `ty::Ref(_region, inner_ty, Mutability::Not)`, checked `inner_ty.is_trivially_pure_clone_copy()`, then checked `self.tcx.is_lang_item(fn_def_id, LangItem::CloneFn)`. It then re-extracted the argument using `take_array(args)`, required `arg.node.place()`, emitted an assignment of the dereferenced argument to the call destination, and replaced the call with `TerminatorKind::Goto { target: destination_block }`.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: For this optimization PR, the historical implementation was not a semantic miscompile; it performed the same guarded clone-call rewrite with redundant work. Specifically, it unwrapped `target` separately, checked `fn_args.len()`, evaluated `inner_ty.is_trivially_pure_clone_copy()` before the lang-item lookup, and re-extracted the already-matched single call argument with `take_array(args)`. The optimization binds `target: Some(destination_block)` in the call pattern, ignores the const-fn generic args, combines the lang-item and trivially-pure checks with the lang-item check first, reuses the earlier `arg` binding, and dereferences the target reference in the final `Goto`. Do not model this as a wrong-output rewrite.
analysis.inputDomain: MIR `TerminatorKind::Call` terminators considered by `InstSimplify::simplify_primitive_clone`: a call with `target: Some(_)`, exactly one MIR argument, a known `const_fn_def`, an argument type of the form `ty::Ref(_, inner_ty, Mutability::Not)`, an `inner_ty` satisfying `is_trivially_pure_clone_copy()`, a callee DefId satisfying `is_lang_item(..., LangItem::CloneFn)`, and an argument node with a place. Calls outside any of these guards are left unchanged.
analysis.summary: `InstSimplify`'s `simplify_primitive_clone` was micro-optimized without changing the recognized rewrite: it now pattern-matches `target: Some(destination_block)`, drops the redundant generic-argument-length check, combines the Clone-lang-item and trivially-pure-copy guards with the cheaper lang-item lookup first, reuses the single matched call argument instead of calling `take_array(args)`, and replaces the call with an assignment plus a `Goto` to the original target. The PR explicitly describes this as redundant-work removal, not a correctness fix. No compiler execution or reproduction was performed.
analysis.trigger: A MIR call terminator to the `CloneFn` lang item on an immutable shared reference to a trivially pure clone-copy type, with exactly one call argument, a known const-fn definition, and a `Some` call target. The pass transforms it into an assignment of the dereferenced argument to the call destination followed by a `Goto` to that target.
preconditions: There is exactly one MIR call argument, enforced by `let [arg] = &args[..] else { return };` (the historical code also later used `take_array(args)`).
The argument type is `ty::Ref(_region, inner_ty, Mutability::Not)`, so the receiver is an immutable shared reference.
The destination and original target must be preserved in the replacement assignment and `Goto`.
pitfalls: `fn_args.len()` in the historical code is the callee's generic arguments length, not the MIR call's argument count. Call arity is separately enforced by the single `[arg]` pattern; do not generalize removal of the `fn_args` check to unrelated lang items.
Both the `LangItem::CloneFn` check and `inner_ty.is_trivially_pure_clone_copy()` check must remain; this PR only changes their order so the cheaper lang-item lookup can reject most calls first.
Only an immutable shared reference (`Mutability::Not`) is accepted; do not rewrite clone calls whose receiver type does not match that shape.
A `Some` call target is required because the rewrite replaces the call with `Goto`; a call without a target must not be transformed.
The argument must still have a place via `arg.node.place()`; otherwise the assignment cannot be formed.

Reusing the earlier `arg` binding instead of `take_array(args)` relies on the borrow of `terminator.kind` ending before `terminator.kind` is overwritten; any refactor must preserve that borrowing discipline.
The optimization preserves the same assignment-plus-`Goto` rewrite; it is not evidence that the old rewrite produced different MIR semantics.
analysis.testStrategy: Use MIR-level tests rather than runtime-output tests. Construct a function such as `fn f(x: u32) -> u32 { x.clone() }` and inspect MIR around `InstSimplify`; the positive case should show the `CloneFn` call replaced by an assignment from `(*_arg)` to the destination and a `Goto` to the original call target. Then make minimal one-condition variants that should remain calls, e.g. clone of a non-trivially-pure type such as `String`, a same-shaped call to a non-lang-item method, and a receiver/type shape that fails the immutable-reference or `place()` requirements. Compare the MIR before and after the pass for the positive case and verify the negative cases are unchanged. The supplied patch contains no regression-test hunk, and no compiler execution or reproduction was performed.
